eligibility_tiers.line: ***As of 1/1/2025, concurrent students must have a 2.5 high school GPA to enroll in concurrent classes at BRTC.

per_credit_hour_charges.line: Beginning Fall 2025, concurrent courses will be billed at a rate of $65 per credit hour. This rate includes the cost of required textbooks and course materials, which will be provided by the BRTC Bookstore on a rental basis.
